title: Top DNS Talkers and Chatty Devices
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pihole:query
| stats count as queries, dc(domain) as unique_domains by client
| sort - queries
| head 15
description: Ranks which devices make the most DNS requests, revealing the chatty smart gadget or the phone phoning home far more than expected.
value: An unusually chatty device can indicate misbehaving firmware or unwanted tracking; ranking talkers makes the oddball obvious.
implementation: Forward the query log; schedule daily and investigate any device whose query volume looks out of place.
visualization: Bar chart of DNS queries by client device.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which of your devices chatter the most on the network, which can reveal a gadget behaving oddly.
